question: Calculate the duration of each track, classify them as short, medium, or long, output the minimum and maximum time for each kind (in minutes) and the total revenue for each category, group by the category.
sql:
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT 
    MIN(Milliseconds) as min_ms,
    MAX(Milliseconds) as max_ms,
    AVG(Milliseconds) as avg_ms
  FROM Track
),
boundaries AS (
  SELECT 
    min_ms,
    max_ms,
    avg_ms,
    (min_ms + avg_ms) / 2.0 as mid_min_avg,
    (avg_ms + max_ms) / 2.0 as mid_avg_max
  FROM stats
),
track_classified AS (
  SELECT 
    t.TrackId,
    t.Milliseconds,
    b.mid_min_avg,
    b.mid_avg_max,
    CASE 
      WHEN t.Milliseconds <= b.mid_min_avg THEN 'Short'
      WHEN t.Milliseconds <= b.mid_avg_max THEN 'Medium'
      ELSE 'Long'
    END as category
  FROM Track t, boundaries b
),
revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    tc.category,
    SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) as total_revenue
  FROM track_classified tc
  JOIN InvoiceLine il ON tc.TrackId = il.TrackId
  GROUP BY tc.category
)
SELECT 
  tc.category,
  ROUND(MIN(tc.Milliseconds / 60000.0), 2) as min_minutes,
  ROUND(MAX(tc.Milliseconds / 60000.0), 2) as max_minutes,
  ROUND(r.total_revenue, 2) as total_revenue
FROM track_classified tc
JOIN revenue r ON tc.category = r.category
GROUP BY tc.category, r.total_revenue
ORDER BY tc.category
